note: 【full想定】単純だが、ナレッジには『3台・先着順・満車時は公共駐車場500円』まで書いてある
subject: Parking
body: Hello, we are driving from Nagoya. Is there parking at your inn?

note: 【条件付き】20時到着。ナレッジは『18時超は要連絡・20時以降は原則お断り、応相談』
subject: Late arrival
body: Our train is delayed and we would arrive around 8pm. Is that OK?

note: 【複合】ベッドの有無＋足の悪い母。ナレッジは『全室和室・ベッド無し』『梅の間だけ段差なし』『エレベーター無し』
subject: Room question
body: My mother has trouble walking and cannot sleep on a futon on the floor. Do you have rooms with beds, and is there an elevator?

note: 【none想定・重要】ペットについてナレッジに一切記載なし → でっち上げず女将へ回るべき
subject: Traveling with our dog
body: We are traveling with a small dog. Is it possible to stay with a pet?

note: 【正直さ】ハラル。ナレッジは『ハラル不可。豚肉除去は可能』と正直に書いてある
subject: Halal food
body: Do you serve halal food? We cannot eat pork.

note: 【計算力】11月=繁忙期、松の間、大人2+小学生1。表と繁忙期定義と子供料金70%を全部読む必要がある
subject: Price for November
body: How much would it be for 2 adults and one 9-year-old child, one night in mid-November? We would like the biggest room if possible.
